name: Zou Zhiying
source: Ember is often seen with Joe. She seems to be his close friend and is always smiling. Being an easy-going and gentle-natured person, Ember doesn't draw much attention. Yet don't be surprised to see her in Joe's bedroom in underwear talking to him in her iconic soothing way. They have a highly dubious relationship to say the least.
